events.text:
T-296 is in review: the equations page is live as one gated Cloudflare copy (name, email, WhatsApp, one workshop link) at https://revops-funnel-equations.growthcluborg.workers.dev/?v=1791531151, GitHub Pages is off (404), and the handoff prompt now says fork and pull request. The live test passed and the sign-up shows in the Tantra Tracker's Funnel Equations tab, with three things to know:

- **Two test rows, not one:** I ran the live test twice, so there are two `wiring-probe` rows.
- **Sign-ups share the Free Registrations tab:** the sheet receiver can't take a new form name without Adi's Google login, so they arrive there tagged `source=funnel-equations` and the tracker sync moves them to their own tab.
- **Monorepo push carried extra commits:** six earlier agent commits that were already waiting on local main went up with mine.
